description: Experimental Qrack-backed Trotter-Suzuki evolution using Pauli exponentials on QrackSimulator.
applicable_hamiltonians: Dense matrix Hamiltonian terms decomposable into real Pauli coefficients
Small to moderate systems where Qrack simulation is available
CPU or GPU-backed Qrack simulator workflows
limitations: Experimental adapter; CPU validation exists, GPU/OpenCL validation depends on host runtime availability
Input terms must be square Hermitian matrices with power-of-two dimension
Currently supports product formula order 1 or 2
Extracts a full unitary matrix by evolving computational basis vectors, which can be expensive

order.description: Product formula order. Qrack adapter currently supports 1 or 2.

is_gpu.description: Whether to request GPU execution from QrackSimulator.

atol.description: Absolute tolerance for Pauli coefficient decomposition.

backend_requirements: GPU/OpenCL runtime only if is_gpu is true
execution.returns: Approximate time-evolution unitary matrix synthesized through Qrack simulation.

complexity.gate_count: Depends on Pauli decomposition, product formula order, and steps
complexity.circuit_depth: Depends on Pauli exponentials, product formula order, and steps
complexity.error_scaling: Product-formula error depends on order, step count, simulation time, and commutator structure
